title: The little known way to become a qualified psychologist - with Anagha Sharma

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?

sentences.zh: 我现在是法医和临床心理学博士课程的二年级实习生，我正在参加

sentences.zh: 伯明翰大学的法医临床心理学博士课程。

sentences.zh: 这似乎是英国目前首个，也是唯一一个，如果我没记错的话。

sentences.zh: 这是第一个结合了法医和临床心理学培训的博士课程。

sentences.en: So it's a four year course.
sentences.zh: 这是一个为期四年的课程。

sentences.en: And essentially it combines elements from the clinical psychology doctorate that's run at
sentences.zh: 它本质上结合了伯明翰大学临床心理学博士课程和法医心理学博士课程的要素。

sentences.en: Birmingham and the forensic psychology doctorate.
sentences.zh: 所以，通常如果你想获得法医和临床心理学双重资格，你必须分别完成两个博士学位，

sentences.en: So in a way, typically that if you wanted to become dual qualified as both a forensic and clinical psychologist, you would have to go and do both doctorates separately, kind of
sentences.zh: 一个接一个地进行。

sentences.en: one after each other.
sentences.zh: 比如先进行临床培训，然后是法医培训，反之亦然。

sentences.en: So you do maybe clinical training first, then forensic or vice versa.
sentences.zh: 但该课程的开发方式是，无需攻读两个博士学位（那可能至少需要六年），它删减并去除了

sentences.en: But the course was developed in a way that instead of doing two doctorates, which then would mean probably about six years at least, it kind of cuts and cuts and gets rid of
sentences.zh: 重叠的部分。

sentences.en: anything that overlaps.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我在临床部分已经学过相关内容，在进行法医教学时就不必重复学习。

sentences.en: So I wouldn't have to do the same teaching again when I'm doing the kind of more forensic teaching if I've had it already in the clinical elements.
sentences.zh: 从这个意义上说，课程的前两年与大学的临床心理学博士课程一致。

sentences.en: So in that sense, the first two years of the course are aligned with the clinical psychology doctorate at the university.
sentences.zh: 所以我接受的是临床教学。

sentences.en: So I have kind of clinical teaching.
sentences.zh: 最后两年则是法医博士课程的内容。

sentences.en: And then the last two years are with the forensic doctorate.
sentences.zh: 我们加入他们的班级，接受法医教学。

sentences.en: So we join their cohort and have the forensic teaching.
sentences.zh: 听起来太棒了。

sentences.en: Sounds amazing.

sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.zh: 所以仍然包括论文，但你只需要写一篇。

sentences.en: So that still includes a thesis, but you'd just be doing one.
sentences.zh: 我想你在第一年就开始收集想法了。

sentences.en: And I guess you start kind of collecting ideas for that in the first year.
sentences.zh: 第二、三、四年就是进行研究的时候。

sentences.en: And then the second, third and fourth years are kind of where that kind of goes ahead.
sentences.zh: 然后在第四年提交。

sentences.en: And then you submit it in your fourth year.
sentences.zh: 所以相比临床培训，你有一年的额外时间来完成论文和撰写工作。

sentences.en: So I guess compared to clinical trainings, you have an extra year then to do your thesis in the write-up.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以这是四年制的课程，毕业后你将获得双重资格，并可以作为两者在 HCPC 和 BPS 注册。

sentences.en: So it's four years and you come out with both and then you can register with the HCPC and the BPS as both.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 哦，太喜欢这个了。

sentences.en: Oh, love that.
sentences.zh: 时间效率也很高。

sentences.en: Time efficiency as well.
sentences.zh: 因为如果四年就能完成，谁想读六年呢？

sentences.en: Because who wants to study for six years if you can do it for four?
sentences.zh: 真的非常好。

sentences.en: Really, really good.
sentences.zh: 我非常钦佩那些两者都完成的人，因为我认为这非常漫长，而且非常辛苦。

sentences.en: I really admire people who've done both because I think it's very long and I think it's a lot of hard work.
sentences.zh: 但能够以更短的路径完成并获得同样的益处，我认为非常重要。

sentences.en: But being able to do it in a shorter route and still have the same benefits, I think is really important.
